<!--
A link to a float in an appendix went to the float in the body with the same
count (wjschne/apaquarto#175). hyperref names a float's anchor after the
bare count, and an appendix starts its count again, so Table A2 got the
anchor table.2, the same as Table 2, and the link to Table A2 opened Table 2.
The reference still read "Table A2", so nothing looked wrong until it was
clicked.

The body and the appendix here each have two tables and a figure, so every
appendix float has a body float with the same count.
-->

# Method

See @tbl-one, @tbl-two, @fig-body, @tbl-apx-one, @tbl-apx-two and @fig-apx.

| A | B |
|:--|--:|
| 1 | 2 |

: The first table. {#tbl-one}

| A | B |
|:--|--:|
| 3 | 4 |

: The second table. {#tbl-two}

![The figure in the body.](sampleimage.png){#fig-body}

# Additional Materials {#apx-a}

| A | B |
|:--|--:|
| 5 | 6 |

: The first table in the appendix. {#tbl-apx-one}

| A | B |
|:--|--:|
| 7 | 8 |

: The second table in the appendix. {#tbl-apx-two}
